places-abric-d-esquarterades-ii-la-fenel.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-abric-d-esquarterades-ii-la-fenel.story: From Ulldecona it runs 94 km to Ulldecona; allow about 1 h 37 of riding. It goes by way of Cova dels Rossegadors o del Polvorin, La fenellosa and back through Cova dels Rossegadors o del Polvorin. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
